name: WinGet-PSADT-GUI-Tool
description: WinGet-PSADT-GUI-Tool is a Windows PowerShell WPF GUI that streamlines Win32 app packaging and Intune deployment. It integrates WinGet search, installer download, PSADT scaffolding, and GUI-driven configuration of install/uninstall/repair logic, enabling generation of .intunewin packages and direct upload to Intune via Microsoft Graph. It outputs standard PSADT/Intune artifacts and provides live monitoring of packaging and upload steps.
author: Dhiraj Dhote

securityCheck.aiSummary: The WinGet-PSADT-GUI-Tool code appears to be a legitimate Intune/PSADT tooling component. The primary concerns are: (1) the use of -EncodedCommand in Invoke-WindowsPowerShellCommand (potential obfuscation; require auditing and potentially avoid); (2) heavy dot-sourcing of many modules at startup (increases attack surface; enforce code signing and integrity checks). No direct remote code execution, credential theft, or data exfiltration is detected in these snippets.
